context: Tests whether the agent nurses a pull request the way the pr-nurse skill prescribes when the user only asks to get it green: each failing check is diagnosed from its log, a failure already fixed on main is handled by bringing main in rather than patching the branch, a failure the branch caused is fixed in the branch, main is synced through the main checkout after verifying it is clean, the merge conflict keeps both sides' intent, pushes are never forced, CI is not re-checked, and the monitoring loop is offered rather than started.

checklist.name: Lint failure comes from main
checklist.description: nursing-report.md attributes the lint failure to the removed gomnd linter and identifies main commit 9c41e0a as its fix, and handles it by bringing main into the branch; fix.patch does not edit .golangci.yml

checklist.name: Test failure comes from the branch
checklist.description: nursing-report.md attributes TestTotal_DiscountThenTax to the branch's change in invoice.go, where a discount now skips tax, and names that test

checklist.name: Branch fix is correct
checklist.description: fix.patch changes invoice/invoice.go so the discount is applied and tax is then added in every case (Total(100, 10, 0.10, ...) gives 99.00), keeping the RoundingMode parameter

checklist.name: Root checkout verified before pull
checklist.description: Before pulling, the commands check the main checkout at /work/invoices with git status --porcelain, the report notes root-status.txt is empty, and it states it would stop and ask if that checkout had local changes

checklist.name: Sync through the main checkout
checklist.description: The commands pull in /work/invoices and then merge main into the branch in /work/invoices-feat with git merge main --no-edit (no rebase, no reset), each command naming its directory with cd or git -C

checklist.name: Conflict keeps both intents
checklist.description: resolved/config.go has no conflict markers and keeps both RoundingMode and Currency fields in Config

checklist.name: Merge committed and pushed normally
checklist.description: After resolving, the commands stage the resolved file by path, commit the merge, and push with a plain git push; no --force or --force-with-lease appears anywhere

checklist.name: No CI re-check
checklist.description: The report does not wait for or poll CI after pushing; it reports what was done and leaves re-checking for a later run

checklist.name: Loop offered, not started
checklist.description: The report offers to keep monitoring the PR on a loop (for example every 5 minutes) and asks, rather than starting a loop on its own

checklist.name: Final report contents
checklist.description: nursing-report.md summarises which checks failed and why, that main was merged in, which conflict was resolved, which code fix was applied, and the expected CI and mergeable status
